title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

series.title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

fullText.simplified:
十一、我好想你们

    米乐看着眼前的小朋友和阿晴，高兴极了！
    “阿晴！是我，是我！！我是米乐！”米乐高兴地说道。
    阿晴不知道米乐在说什么，她看见眼前这只黑黑的小柯基在摇尾巴。
    “阿晴！我好想你，好想季南，我真的好想你们！”米乐又说道。
    阿晴摸了摸这只小柯基，他的叫声已经越来越小了。他一定是太累了，太饿了。
    “阿晴！季南呢？季南在哪里？他一定健健康康的，对不对？”米乐不停地说着。
    阿晴不认识这只小柯基，但是她觉得这只狗一定在和自己说着什么。阿晴决定把小柯基带回家去。他们的大金毛米乐死后，他们已经好多年没有狗了。阿晴想：“希望这一次季南会愿意让这只小柯基住下。”
    米乐睡着了，等他再起来，他看见一个男人坐在地上。这个男人看着照片，米乐看不见他的样子。米乐一步一步地走过去，他每走一步就动动自己的小鼻子。他要闻一闻，他想知道这个人是不是季南。他多么希望这个人是季南，是他每天都在想的季南啊！突然男人看向了他，就那么一眼，米乐不动了，然后就飞快地跑了上去。是他！真的是他！我终于找到了季南了！
    米乐跳到了季南的身上，一声又一声地叫着。他不停地摇着尾巴，有好多好多话想和季南说，但他不知道从哪里开始说，所以就一声又一声地叫着。
    看见这么热情的狗，季南笑了起来。他摸摸这只小狗的头，说：“好狗，好狗！你是认识我吗？你太热情了。”
fullText.traditional:
十一、我好想你們

    米樂看著眼前的小朋友和阿晴，高興極了！
    “阿晴！是我，是我！！我是米樂！”米樂高興地說道。
    阿晴不知道米樂在說什麼，她看見眼前這隻黑黑的小柯基在搖尾巴。
    “阿晴！我好想你，好想季南，我真的好想你們！”米樂又說道。
    阿晴摸了摸這隻小柯基，他的叫聲已經越來越小了。他一定是太累了，太餓了。
    “阿晴！季南呢？季南在哪裡？他一定健健康康的，對不對？”米樂不停地說著。
    阿晴不認識這隻小柯基，但是她覺得這隻狗一定在和自己說著什麼。阿晴決定把小柯基帶回家去。他們的大金毛米樂死後，他們已經好多年沒有狗了。阿晴想：“希望這一次季南會願意讓這隻小柯基住下。”
    米樂睡著了，等他再起來，他看見一個男人坐在地上。這個男人看著照片，米樂看不見他的樣子。米樂一步一步地走過去，他每走一步就動動自己的小鼻子。他要聞一聞，他想知道這個人是不是季南。他多麼希望這個人是季南，是他每天都在想的季南啊！突然男人看向了他，就那麼一眼，米樂不動了，然後就飛快地跑了上去。是他！真的是他！我終於找到了季南了！
    米樂跳到了季南的身上，一聲又一聲地叫著。他不停地搖著尾巴，有好多好多話想和季南說，但他不知道從哪裡開始說，所以就一聲又一聲地叫著。
    看見這麼熱情的狗，季南笑了起來。他摸摸這隻小狗的頭，說：“好狗，好狗！你是認識我嗎？你太熱情了。”

sentences.english: Mi Le looked at the child and A Qing in front of him and was very happy!

sentences.simplified: “阿晴！是我，是我！！我是米乐！”米乐高兴地说道。
sentences.traditional: “阿晴！是我，是我！！我是米樂！”米樂高興地說道。
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng shì wǒ shì wǒ wǒ shì mǐ lè mǐ lè gāo xìng de shuō dào
sentences.english: “A Qing! It’s me, it’s me!! I’m Mi Le!” said Mi Le happily.

sentences.simplified: 阿晴不知道米乐在说什么，她看见眼前这只黑黑的小柯基在摇尾巴。
sentences.traditional: 阿晴不知道米樂在說什麼，她看見眼前這隻黑黑的小柯基在搖尾巴。
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng bù zhī dào mǐ lè zài shuō shén me tā kàn jiàn yǎn qián zhè zhī hēi hēi de xiǎo kē jī zài yáo wěi ba
sentences.english: A Qing didn’t know Mi Le was saying something. She saw the little black corgi wagging its tail in front of her.

sentences.simplified: “阿晴！我好想你，好想季南，我真的好想你们！”米乐又说道。
sentences.traditional: “阿晴！我好想你，好想季南，我真的好想你們！”米樂又說道。
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng wǒ hǎo xiǎng nǐ hǎo xiǎng jì nán wǒ zhēn de hǎo xiǎng nǐ men mǐ lè yòu shuō dào
sentences.english: “A Qing! I’ve really missed you. I’ve really missed Ji Nan. I’ve really missed you both!” Mi Le added.

sentences.simplified: 阿晴摸了摸这只小柯基，他的叫声已经越来越小了。他一定是太累了，太饿了。
sentences.traditional: 阿晴摸了摸這隻小柯基，他的叫聲已經越來越小了。他一定是太累了，太餓了。
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng mō le mō zhè zhī xiǎo kē jī tā de jiào shēng yǐ jīng yuè lái yuè xiǎo le tā yí dìng shì tài lèi le tài è le
sentences.english: A Qing stroked the little corgi. His barking became quieter and quieter. He must have been too tired and too hungry.

sentences.simplified: “阿晴！季南呢？季南在哪里？他一定健健康康的，对不对？”米乐不停地说着。
sentences.traditional: “阿晴！季南呢？季南在哪裡？他一定健健康康的，對不對？”米樂不停地說著。
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng jì nán ne jì nán zài nǎ lǐ tā yí dìng jiàn jiàn kāng kāng de duì bú duì mǐ lè bù tíng de shuō zhe
sentences.english: “A Qing! What about Ji Nan? Where is Ji Nan? He must be in good health, right?” Mi Le talked incessantly.

sentences.simplified: 阿晴不认识这只小柯基，但是她觉得这只狗一定在和自己说着什么。
sentences.traditional: 阿晴不認識這隻小柯基，但是她覺得這隻狗一定在和自己說著什麼。
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng bú rèn shi zhè zhī xiǎo kē jī dàn shì tā jué de zhè zhī gǒu yí dìng zài hé zì jǐ shuō zhe shén me
sentences.english: A Qing didn’t recognize the little corgi, but she felt that the dog was trying to tell her something.

sentences.simplified: 阿晴决定把小柯基带回家去。他们的大金毛米乐死后，他们已经好多年没有狗了。
sentences.traditional: 阿晴決定把小柯基帶回家去。他們的大金毛米樂死後，他們已經好多年沒有狗了。
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng jué dìng bǎ xiǎo kē jī dài huí jiā qù tā men de dà jīn máo mǐ lè sǐ hòu tā men yǐ jīng hǎo duō nián méi yǒu gǒu le
sentences.english: A Qing decided to take the little corgi home with her. They hadn’t had a dog for many years after their big goldie Mi Le died.

sentences.simplified: 阿晴想：“希望这一次季南会愿意让这只小柯基住下。”
sentences.traditional: 阿晴想：“希望這一次季南會願意讓這隻小柯基住下。”
sentences.pinyin: ā qíng xiǎng xī wàng zhè yí cì jì nán huì yuàn yì ràng zhè zhī xiǎo kē jī zhù xià
sentences.english: A Qing thought, “I hope Ji Nan will be willing to let this little corgi stay this time.”

sentences.simplified: 米乐睡着了，等他再起来，他看见一个男人坐在地上。
sentences.traditional: 米樂睡著了，等他再起來，他看見一個男人坐在地上。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè shuì zháo le děng tā zài qǐ lái tā kàn jiàn yí ge nán rén zuò zài dì shang
sentences.english: Mi Le fell asleep, and when he woke up again, he saw a man sitting on the floor.

sentences.simplified: 这个男人看着照片，米乐看不见他的样子。
sentences.traditional: 這個男人看著照片，米樂看不見他的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge nán rén kàn zhe zhào piàn mǐ lè kàn bú jiàn tā de yàng zi
sentences.english: The man was looking at pictures, and Mi Le couldn’t see what he looked like.

sentences.simplified: 米乐一步一步地走过去，他每走一步就动动自己的小鼻子。
sentences.traditional: 米樂一步一步地走過去，他每走一步就動動自己的小鼻子。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè yí bù yí bù de zǒu guò qu tā měi zǒu yí bù jiù dòng dòng zì jǐ de xiǎo bí zi
sentences.english: Mi Le walked over one step at a time, moving his little nose with every step he took.

sentences.simplified: 他要闻一闻，他想知道这个人是不是季南。
sentences.traditional: 他要聞一聞，他想知道這個人是不是季南。
sentences.pinyin: tā yào wén yì wén tā xiǎng zhī dào zhè ge rén shì bú shì jì nán
sentences.english: He wanted to smell him. He wanted to know if this person was Ji Nan.

sentences.simplified: 他多么希望这个人是季南，是他每天都在想的季南啊！
sentences.traditional: 他多麼希望這個人是季南，是他每天都在想的季南啊！
sentences.pinyin: tā duō me xī wàng zhè ge rén shì jì nán shì tā měi tiān dōu zài xiǎng de jì nán a
sentences.english: How he wished this person was Ji Nan, the Ji Nan he thought of every day!

sentences.simplified: 突然男人看向了他，就那么一眼，米乐不动了，然后就飞快地跑了上去。
sentences.traditional: 突然男人看向了他，就那麼一眼，米樂不動了，然後就飛快地跑了上去。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán nán rén kàn xiàng le tā jiù nà me yì yǎn mǐ lè bú dòng le rán hòu jiù fēi kuài de pǎo le shàng qù
sentences.english: Suddenly the man looked at him, and just with that one look, Mi Le stopped moving, and then he ran over at lightning speed.

sentences.simplified: 是他！真的是他！我终于找到了季南了！
sentences.traditional: 是他！真的是他！我終於找到了季南了！
sentences.pinyin: shì tā zhēn de shì tā wǒ zhōng yú zhǎo dào le jì nán le
sentences.english: It’s him! It’s really him! I’ve finally found Ji Nan!

sentences.simplified: 米乐跳到了季南的身上，一声又一声地叫着。
sentences.traditional: 米樂跳到了季南的身上，一聲又一聲地叫著。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè tiào dào le jì nán de shēn shang yì shēng yòu yì shēng de jiào zhe
sentences.english: Mi Le jumped onto Ji Nan and kept barking. He wagged his tail incessantly.

sentences.simplified: 他不停地摇着尾巴，有好多好多话想和季南说，但他不知道从哪里开始说，所以就一声又一声地叫着。
sentences.traditional: 他不停地搖著尾巴，有好多好多話想和季南說，但他不知道從哪裡開始說，所以就一聲又一聲地叫著。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù tíng de yáo zhe wěi ba yǒu hǎo duō hǎo duō huà xiǎng hé jì nán shuō dàn tā bù zhī dào cóng nǎ lǐ kāi shǐ shuō suǒ yǐ jiù yì shēng yòu yì shēng de jiào zhe
sentences.english: There was so much he wanted to say to Ji Nan, but he didn’t know where to start, so he just kept barking.

sentences.simplified: 看见这么热情的狗，季南笑了起来。
sentences.traditional: 看見這麼熱情的狗，季南笑了起來。
sentences.pinyin: kàn jiàn zhè me rè qíng de gǒu jì nán xiào le qǐ lái
sentences.english: Seeing such an enthusiastic dog made Ji Nan laugh.

sentences.simplified: 他摸摸这只小狗的头，说：“好狗，好狗！你是认识我吗？你太热情了。”
sentences.traditional: 他摸摸這隻小狗的頭，說：“好狗，好狗！你是認識我嗎？你太熱情了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā mō mō zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu de tóu shuō hǎo gǒu hǎo gǒu nǐ shì rèn shi wǒ ma nǐ tài rè qíng le
sentences.english: He stroked the puppy’s head and said, “Good dog, good dog! Do you recognize me? You’re very enthusiastic.”

sentence_translations: (11) I’ve Really Missed You Both
Mi Le looked at the child and A Qing in front of him and was very happy!
“A Qing! It’s me, it’s me!! I’m Mi Le!” said Mi Le happily.
A Qing didn’t know Mi Le was saying something. She saw the little black corgi wagging its tail in front of her.
“A Qing! I’ve really missed you. I’ve really missed Ji Nan. I’ve really missed you both!” Mi Le added.
A Qing stroked the little corgi. His barking became quieter and quieter. He must have been too tired and too hungry.
“A Qing! What about Ji Nan? Where is Ji Nan? He must be in good health, right?” Mi Le talked incessantly.
A Qing didn’t recognize the little corgi, but she felt that the dog was trying to tell her something.
A Qing decided to take the little corgi home with her. They hadn’t had a dog for many years after their big goldie Mi Le died.
A Qing thought, “I hope Ji Nan will be willing to let this little corgi stay this time.”
Mi Le fell asleep, and when he woke up again, he saw a man sitting on the floor.
The man was looking at pictures, and Mi Le couldn’t see what he looked like.
Mi Le walked over one step at a time, moving his little nose with every step he took.
He wanted to smell him. He wanted to know if this person was Ji Nan.
How he wished this person was Ji Nan, the Ji Nan he thought of every day!
Suddenly the man looked at him, and just with that one look, Mi Le stopped moving, and then he ran over at lightning speed.
It’s him! It’s really him! I’ve finally found Ji Nan!
Mi Le jumped onto Ji Nan and kept barking. He wagged his tail incessantly.
There was so much he wanted to say to Ji Nan, but he didn’t know where to start, so he just kept barking.
Seeing such an enthusiastic dog made Ji Nan laugh.
He stroked the puppy’s head and said, “Good dog, good dog! Do you recognize me? You’re very enthusiastic.”
